title: Study: Exercise increases cancer survival rates
summary: A peer-reviewed study from the New England Journal of Medicine demonstrating that regular physical exercise is associated with improved survival rates among cancer patients, providing clinical evidence for exercise as a supportive intervention in cancer treatment protocols.
problem_solved: Addresses the knowledge gap regarding the direct impact of exercise on cancer patient outcomes and survival rates.
why_valuable: Provides evidence-based medical guidance that can inform treatment recommendations and potentially improve cancer patient prognosis through non-pharmacological intervention.
